snippet.title: Feed the Queen - Official Release Date Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Release Date Trailer for Feed the Queen, a strategic colony simulation game developed by Quiétude. Players will seek out food to continue the colony's growth. Make new synergies, create specialized workers, and feed the queen above all else. Feed the Queen is launching on May 25 for PC (Steam).
